name: westland
description: Westland Construction organizational plugin — always-loaded safety hooks and progressively-disclosed company style references. Install this first on every Westland machine (it's a required dependency of the domain plugins like scheduling, estimating, etc.). Contains: XER immutability PreToolUse hook (blocks in-place edits, overwrites, and deletes of .xer project records) and a westland-house-style skill for formatting conventions on company documents.
